name: Kisaragi Mizuho
source:
"Cheering for someone will make that person try harder. Thinking that, courage wells up in me to try harder as well."

The daughter of Kyouko, who is a 3rd year student at Rokujou school. A member of her school's cheer club, she's regarded to as the goddess of victory due to her beauty, and is popular to men and women alike. She hopes that the ones she cheer on will gain a little courage to try harder, and with that desire, she does her best as a cheerleader. She's quite athletic, and was into swimming before she entered Rokujou School. 

Holds a very caring personality, has many friends, hates to lose, and tends to get stubborn on trivial stuff. She's punctual when it comes to housework, but her weird sense of taste makes her cooking quite dicey. Is bad at mornings, and tends to snooze her alarm clock 5 times. 

Is on good terms with her little sister Kotomi, and she spoils her as an older sister. Doesn't complain with her father who's always away for work, and respects her mother so much who takes care of the house. She wants to be a woman like her mother someday, and because of that she's a bit old fashioned. She thinks its ideal to bear a child after marriage, then dedicate her time as a wife in the upbringing of her child while supporting her husband. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.bootup.jp/products/amaie/chara_mizuho.html]Official Site[/url]]
